subject: Re: Project Palisade kickoff: fact tracing for LM assertions
body:
Anders,

Palisade staffing and compute:

- Linnea Yamada 50% tech lead, owns the benchmark reproduction and methodology.
- Chiara Olsen 40% Feb-Apr on the corpus-slice indexing (BM25 side plus the embedding index).
- Amara Okafor 30% on gradient-computation infra — the gradient-based TDA methods need per-example gradients, which is the expensive part.

Compute: 24 A100s on titan-a100 best-effort for the gradient extraction runs in March; embedding and BM25 passes are cheap. No reservation-class ask this window.

One flag: per-example gradients on the corpus slice will dominate our budget — Amara estimates ~9k GPU-hours if we do the full slice naively. She's implementing the release's suggested last-layer approximation first, and we only go deeper if precision demands it.

Alina
